label: Checking with restaurant
text: Checking with the restaurant now, one moment please.

label: Refund processed
text: Your refund has been processed and should appear within 3-5 business days.

label: Ask for screenshot
text: Could you send a screenshot of the error you're seeing? That'll help us track it down faster.

label: Reservation confirmed
text: Good news - your reservation is confirmed. You should also see it reflected in the app now.

label: Ask for more info
text: Thanks for reaching out. Could you share a bit more detail, like the reservation time and restaurant name, so we can look into this?

label: Escalated notice
text: I've escalated this to our team and we're looking into it - I'll update you as soon as I hear back.

label: Resolved, closing
text: Glad we could sort this out! I'll go ahead and close this ticket. Feel free to reach out again if anything else comes up.

label: Apology for delay
text: Sorry for the delay in getting back to you - thanks for your patience.
